        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform for reporting, processing, and settling claims" {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress" "Web Application" "Web"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app" "REST API" "API"
            claimsIntake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims" "Microservice" "Service"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims" "Microservice" "Service"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts" "Microservice" "Service"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements" "Microservice" "Service"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims" "Microservice" "Service"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports" "Microservice" "Service"
            notification = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders" "Microservice" "Service"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters" "Microservice" "Service"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims" "Web Application" "Web"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy" "Microservice" "Service"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners" "Microservice" "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation" "Batch Job" "Batch"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts" "Message Queue" "Queue"
            claimsDb = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records" "Relational Database" "Database"
            policyDb = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records" "Relational Database" "Database"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail" "Relational Database" "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence" "Object Storage" "Storage"
        }

        claimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization" "External"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization" "External"

        # Policyholders use the platform to report claims and track their progress
        policyholder -> claimsCenter.webPortal "reports claims and tracks their progress" "HTTPS"
        policyholder -> claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks their progress" "HTTPS"

        # The web portal and the mobile app backend reach the intake, assessment, payout, document, and notification services
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.claimsIntake "submits new claims to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.assessment "requests settlement amounts from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.payout "requests settlements from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.documentService "uploads claim photos and reports to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.webPortal -> claimsCenter.notification "requests status notifications from" "HTTPS"

        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.claimsIntake "submits new claims to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.assessment "requests settlement amounts from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.payout "requests settlements from" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.documentService "uploads claim photos and reports to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.mobileAppBackend -> claimsCenter.notification "requests status notifications from" "HTTPS"

        # The claims intake service hands accepted claims to the triage service, the triage service routes them to the assessment service, and the assessment service requests settlements from the payout service
        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.triage "hands accepted claims to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.triage -> claimsCenter.assessment "routes claims to" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.assessment -> claimsCenter.payout "requests settlements from" "HTTPS"

        # The fraud screening service screens each incoming claim, the policy verification service checks the cover, and the assignment service routes the claim to the adjuster workbench
        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.fraudScreening "sends incoming claims for screening" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.policyVerification "sends claims for cover verification" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.claimsIntake -> claimsCenter.assignment "sends claims for assignment" "HTTPS"
        claimsCenter.assignment -> claimsCenter.adjusterWorkbench "routes claims to" "HTTPS"

        # The document service reads from the document store, the batch scheduler reads and writes the claims and policy databases, and the notification service reports claim status changes
        claimsCenter.documentService -> claimsCenter.documentStore "reads from" "TCP"
        claimsCenter.batchScheduler -> claimsCenter.claimsDb "reads and writes" "SQL"
        claimsCenter.batchScheduler -> claimsCenter.policyDb "reads and writes" "SQL"
        claimsCenter.notification -> policyholder "reports claim status changes by email and message" "SMTP, SMS"

        # The fraud screening service consults a national claims data bureau operated by a different organization
        claimsCenter.fraudScreening -> claimsDataBureau "consults claims data" "HTTPS"

        # The payout service executes settlements through a clearing house operated by a different organization
        claimsCenter.payout -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through" "HTTPS"
    }

    views {

        systemContext claimsCenter "ClaimsCenterContext" "System context for the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "Claims Center - System Context"
        }

        container claimsCenter "ClaimsCenterContainers" "Containers of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "Claims Center - Containers"
        }

        styles {
            element "Person" {
                shape Person
                background #08427B
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Software System" {
                background #1168BD
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "External" {
                background #999999
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Web" {
                shape WebBrowser
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "API" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Service" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Batch" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Queue" {
                shape Pipe
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Database" {
                shape Cylinder
                background #336791
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Storage" {
                background #336791
                color #ffffff
            }
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope softwaresystem
    }
}
